content.short: Fraction.Estate democratizes real estate investing through fractional ownership and tokenized shares on Cardano.
content.description: Fraction.Estate is an innovative Real-World Asset (RWA) project that leverages the Cardano blockchain to make real estate investing accessible to everyone. By fractionalizing high-value properties into tradable NFTs, the platform allows individuals to own a portion of a property for as little as $50. Investors benefit from monthly rental income distributed directly on-chain, providing a transparent and liquid alternative to traditional property markets. Fraction.Estate combines legal compliance with blockchain efficiency to bridge the gap between physical real estate and digital liquidity.
content.meta: Fraction.Estate offers fractional real estate ownership through NFTs on the Cardano blockchain. Explore the project on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
